adapters.applicable: Static posters and print-oriented text-led visual communication
focus: Viewing distance and physical output dimensions
Contrast, real font availability and print requirements
limits: No automatic print-ready certification, CMYK, bleed or ICC validation

adapters.applicable: Static social-media images, not video or interactive social content
focus: Hierarchy at actual mobile display size
Audience, safe areas and source/claim integrity
limits: No image-generation engine or platform template guarantee

adapters.applicable: Static digital banner images, not HTML or interactive banner units
focus: Legibility at the actual banner dimensions
limits: Interactive Web banners require a Web profile; do not certify click behavior from a static image

adapters.applicable: Landing pages and marketing campaign web pages
focus: Real claims, hierarchy and actual CTA
Responsive rendering, links and interaction states

adapters.applicable: Paginated reports and text-heavy distributed documents
focus: Figures, captions, tables, notes and reading order
Font fallback and exact protected data
limits: Rendering must be checked in the actual supported document/export environment
